purpose: Resolve the actual concurrent WAL-initialization failure before releasing v0.7.0; do not reinterpret an unsuccessful CI run as a pass.
implementation_constraints: Only retry a transient SQLITE_BUSY from the WAL-mode transition; preserve other initialization errors and existing close-on-error behavior.
Use a single bounded elapsed-time budget covering the first attempt and later waits; no unbounded retry or process-local-only locking.
Keep the successful normal path to one WAL statement and no added SQL round trips.
Retain Python 3.10 support and the existing schema, source IDs, ranking, budgets and cache version.
required_validation: A real SQLite lock-contention regression that fails on the prior source and succeeds after the correction.
Bounded exhaustion, non-busy error propagation and connection cleanup checks; retain the original concurrent-initializer test.
Publish the corrected runtime as a new Afloat16 commit before recording its final-source replay.
Run the unchanged scope diagnostic against the corrected runtime in a new output directory; require all existing scope contracts and 35 legacy response/error pairs to remain passing.

Run the unchanged 80-question native engineering workload at 1200 and 2400 characters, once per setting, and independently compare all 160 Book and 640 total non-timing responses with the unchanged v0.6.0 baseline.
Recompute source-bound native scores and evidence using the same fixed auditor rules, with explicit corrected commit/tree identity; keep the original cf51473 replay intact.
Require a passing final local suite with explicit skips and all nine hosted CI jobs on the final publication source.
Register the corrected runtime hash only with its completed evidence, then rebuild and verify the final release assets and public installer.
evidence_policy: Retain every observed failed run and raw output. Do not tune workloads, alter score definitions or add a performance claim. Identity parameters may identify the new frozen source but cannot be inferred from the report being audited.
reference_scope: SQLite documents that the busy handler is not guaranteed to run under contention; the particular failure and proposed correction are based on this repository's actual CI trace and regression.
